In this notebook, I will make plots for Supplemental Figure 11

# Setup

```{r setup}
library(scales)
library(tidyverse)
library(ggradar)

thisseed <- 231103

colFGID <- "#1E88E5"
coliCD <- "#55D276"
colcCD <- "#FFC107"
colUC <- "#D81B60"
colIBD <- "#EB6D33"
diagSubColVec <- c("FGID"=colFGID, "iCD" = coliCD, "cCD"=colcCD, "UC"=colUC)


colNM <- "#6b6a6a"
colNOA <- "#bfbfbf"
colFR <- "#11d6cc"
colPR <- "#ff8c00"
colNR <- "#ff1e00"
atnfColVec <- c("NM"=colNM, "NOA"=colNOA,"FR"=colFR,"PR"=colPR,"NR"=colNR)
```


```{r}
combined.df <- readRDS("out/summary/251017__tcellfeatures.rds")
combined.df
```

```{r}
combined.df.scaled <- combined.df %>% 
  mutate_at(vars(-biopsy:-huprot), scales::rescale)

combined.df.scaled
```

```{r}
combined.df.scaled.plot <- combined.df.scaled %>% 
  rowwise %>% 
  mutate(`Th1\nFeatures` = mean(c(Th1, GeomMean_Th1, IFNG, STAT1, TNFa))) %>% 
  mutate(`Th17\nFeatures` = mean(c(Th17, GeomMean_Th17, IL17A, Antimicrobial, Chemokine))) %>%
  mutate(`PD1Hi Tfh\nFeatures` = mean(c(`PD1Hi Tfh`, `IgG1 PC`, GeomMean_Tfh, CXCL13,  mTiRP))) %>% 
  select(-`IgG1 PC`:-`mTiRP`) %>% 
  ungroup %>% 
  drop_na

combined.df.scaled.plot
```

```{r}
combined.df.scaled.plot %>% count(diagSub, timepoint, antitnf_response)
```

```{r}
combined.df.scaled.plot %>% filter(diagSub == "UC" & timepoint == "T0") %>%  count(huprot)
```

```{r}
partdiagColVec <- diagSubColVec[combined.df.scaled.plot$diagSub]
names(partdiagColVec) <- combined.df.scaled.plot$participant_id
partdiagColVec
```

# Plots

```{r, fig.height=8, fig.width=10}
p <- combined.df.scaled.plot %>%
  filter(timepoint == "T0") %>% 
  select(participant_id, `Th1\nFeatures`, `Th17\nFeatures`, `PD1Hi Tfh\nFeatures`) %>% 
  ggradar(
    grid.label.size = 0,  
    axis.label.size = 8.5,
    group.line.width = 1,
    group.point.size = 2,
    gridline.mid.colour = "grey",
    background.circle.transparency = 0.2,
    fill = T, 
    fill.alpha = 0.025,
    centre.y = 0, 
    group.colours = NULL,
  ) + 
  guides(fill = "none") +
  scale_color_manual(values = partdiagColVec) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = partdiagColVec) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.text = element_text(size = 24, face = "bold")
  ) + 
  guides(color = guide_legend(nrow = 1))

# https://stackoverflow.com/questions/61105285/manually-adjust-alpha-after-plot-is-created
p$layers[[9]]$aes_params$alpha <- 0.25 # line alpha
p$layers[[10]]$aes_params$alpha <- 0.5 # dot alpha

p$layers[[10]]$aes_params$stroke <- 1

p
```

```{r, fig.height=8, fig.width=10}
p <- combined.df.scaled.plot %>%
  filter(timepoint == "T0") %>% 
  select(diagSub, `Th1\nFeatures`, `Th17\nFeatures`, `PD1Hi Tfh\nFeatures`) %>% 
  mutate(diagSub = fct_rev(diagSub)) %>% 
  ggradar(
    grid.label.size = 0,  
    axis.label.size = 8.5,
    group.line.width = 3,
    group.point.size = 7.5,
    gridline.mid.colour = "grey",
    background.circle.transparency = 0.2,
    fill = T, 
    fill.alpha = 0.15,
    centre.y = 0
  ) + 
  guides(fill = "none") +
  scale_color_manual(values = diagSubColVec) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = diagSubColVec) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.text = element_text(size = 24, face = "bold")
  )

# https://stackoverflow.com/questions/61105285/manually-adjust-alpha-after-plot-is-created
p$layers[[9]]$aes_params$alpha <- 0.75 # line alpha
p$layers[[10]]$aes_params$alpha <- 0.75 # dot alpha

p
```

```{r, fig.height=8, fig.width=10}
p <- combined.df.scaled.plot %>%
  filter(timepoint == "T0" & diagSub == "cCD" & antitnf_response %in% c("NOA", "FR", "PR", "NR")) %>% 
  select(antitnf_response, `Th1\nFeatures`, `Th17\nFeatures`, `PD1Hi Tfh\nFeatures`) %>% 
  ggradar(
    grid.label.size = 0,  
    axis.label.size = 8.5,
    group.line.width = 3,
    group.point.size = 7.5,
    gridline.mid.colour = "grey",
    background.circle.transparency = 0.2,
    fill = T, 
    fill.alpha = 0.15,
    centre.y = 0
  ) + 
  guides(fill = "none") +
  scale_color_manual(values = atnfColVec,
                     labels = c("Not on Anti-TNF", "Full Responder", "Partial Responder")
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = atnfColVec) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.text = element_text(size = 20, face = "bold")
  )

# https://stackoverflow.com/questions/61105285/manually-adjust-alpha-after-plot-is-created
p$layers[[9]]$aes_params$alpha <- 0.75 # line alpha
p$layers[[10]]$aes_params$alpha <- 0.75 # dot alpha

p
```

```{r, fig.height=8, fig.width=10}
p <- combined.df.scaled.plot %>%
  filter(timepoint == "T0" & diagSub == "UC") %>% 
  mutate(anca = ifelse(participant_id %in% c("001-036", "001-038"), "ENO1+", "ENO1-")) %>% 
  mutate(anca = fct_relevel(anca, c("ENO1+", "ENO1-"))) %>% 
  select(anca, `Th1\nFeatures`, `Th17\nFeatures`, `PD1Hi Tfh\nFeatures`) %>% 
  ggradar(
    grid.label.size = 0,  
    axis.label.size = 8.5,
    group.line.width = 3,
    group.point.size = 7.5,
    gridline.mid.colour = "grey",
    background.circle.transparency = 0.2,
    fill = T, 
    fill.alpha = 0.25,
    centre.y = 0
    # group.colours = T
  ) + 
  guides(fill = "none") +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("ENO1+" = "purple", "ENO1-" = "gray60")) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("ENO1+" = "purple", "ENO1-" = "gray60")) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.text = element_text(size = 24, face = "bold")
  )

# https://stackoverflow.com/questions/61105285/manually-adjust-alpha-after-plot-is-created
p$layers[[9]]$aes_params$alpha <- 0.75 # line alpha
p$layers[[10]]$aes_params$alpha <- 0.75 # dot alpha

p
```
